messages:
marta: Quick sync on zephyrus-3b (open) intake — want to close gating checklist this week. Need: 1) legal license signoff, 2) perf profile (p50/p95 for 128/512 tokens), 3) quantization rec, 4) infra owner for dedicated canary, 5) short catalog blurb for docs. pinging owners and legal.

kevin: I can take infra/canary. Need target SLOs from product + a suggested canary window. Also what hardware are we targeting (T4, A10, H100)?

olivia: Legal: we need the model license text + whether there are any additional contributor agreements. @legal-bot can you run a quick license scan and flag anything non-OSI? :eyes:

legal-bot: license-scan complete — candidate shows Apache-2.0-like header but includes third-party weights with "restricted-commercial" clause in one file. Manual review required. @anya please triage.

anya: noted — I'll take a manual pass today. If we see a restricted clause we need to confirm permitted use for hosted API vs private-only. ETA EOD.

harper: ran microbench on a10g (batch=8, seq=128): p50=38ms p95=110ms tokens/sec=280 quant=fp16. Quick 4-bit trial looks ok but p95 regresses ~15% (still within canary threshold maybe). Snippet:
```
model: zephyrus-3b
hw: a10g
batch: 8
seq: 128
results: { p50: 38, p95: 110, tps: 280 }
```

marta: good data — for catalog we need the perf table for both 128 and 512. harper can you add 512 runs tomorrow?

kevin: for canary plan: propose 24h canary on dedicated pool with autoscale min=1 max=4, traffic ramping 1%->10%->50% over 3 windows. config snippet: `canary:{duration:24h, ramps:[1,10,50], pool:zephyrus-canary}`. deploy-bot, can you reserve pool?

deploy-bot: reserving pool zephyrus-canary on region us-west2, slot requested: 2 GPUs. ETA provisioning ~2h.

olivia: thanks, team. once Anya confirms license, legal will mark hosted vs private gating. if restricted clause exists we may only list model in private catalog with an ops note.

harper: added 512 runs to my queue, will post numbers here when done. Also saw minor tokenizer oddness on some inputs — filing small issue: https://go/repo/issue/ZE-12

marta: assigning action items: (1) Anya legal manual check (anya), (2) harper perf 512 + quant runs (harper), (3) kevin infra canary setup + SLOs (kevin), (4) docs blurb draft (marta/olivia). Will update the onboarding sheet after we get license result.

kevin: noted, starting canary config now. I’ll also add a prometheus dashboard snippet for token latency.

olivia: if legal passes, I'll queue the model page draft and tag product for SLOs.

anya: quick update — initial manual looks OK except for one weight file; pinging upstream author for clarification. ETA ~4h.

marta: perfect — thanks everyone. I’ll keep this thread as the single source for gating updates. :thumbsup:
